siteSubtitle: A Comprehensive Guide to The Story of Mel

menuDescriptions.about: Mel's Loop is a guide to the epic hacker folklore tale "The Story of Mel". It also aims to collect the stories and sub-stories around the tale, its author, and its main characters, as well as early computing era stories and other related tales.

contact.pageSubtitle: We'd love to hear from you about anything and everything!
contact.pageText: As our community of developers and hackers is growing we'd love to hear your thoughts, ideas, recommendations and feedbacks. Use this contact form to deliver your message directly to us, and we will get back to you shortly via e-mail. You're also welcome to e-mail us at about@melsloop.com.
